item.title: Household waste, builders' rubbish, food waste, dumped furniture and toysunfinished building work in the middle of the pavement, 3rd August
item.description:
The corner of Gipsy Road/Rommany Road is a disgusting eyesore and gets worse each day. Piles of household and food waste are lying open and on the pavement. Flytipped cupboards and toys are added on top. The builders renovating the flats use the pavement in place of a tip and have left wires exposed and works unfinished. This has been an ongoing problem for many months but this is the worst it has been. It is both unsafe and unsanitary in addition to being extremely unsightly. Come on, Lambeth - sort this out!!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 195, Gipsy Road, West Norwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
